documents.title: Documents
documents.restrictedDefault: New documents are restricted by default
documents.editFilesHelp: Upload and manage files from the document page. Cancelling this form only discards content edits.
documents.conflict: This document changed in another session
documents.conflictHelp: Your draft is preserved. Reload explicitly to replace it with the latest saved version.
documents.fileConflict: The document changed. The latest version was loaded; review it before trying the file action again.
documents.editorRequired: Keep at least one editor with document management permission.

visibilityHelp.company: Everyone in the current company with document read permission can read this document.
visibilityHelp.restricted: Only explicitly granted people can read it. Editors also need document management permission.

documents.optionalDetailsHelp: Optional: set an expiry date, link a record, or add tags to make the document easier to find.
documents.bodyHelp: Optional. A document can contain text or files only.
documents.createFilesHelp: After creating the document, you can upload files from its page.
documents.noResultsHelp: Try different words or clear the filters to see available documents.
documents.emptyHelp: Documents you have access to will appear here.
